# Bench B + baselines tables (generated by summarize.py)

vote = consistency medoid; d0 = draw 0 (greedy for the Qwen-family models, sampled for DeepSeek); fe = first executing draw;
mean = mean candidate IoU; bo = best-of-8 (oracle); ex = execution rate. Paired 95% bootstrap CIs.
